effects.detects: disembodied spirits, incorporeal Undead, manifested haunts and active possessing entities

effects.text: Entities perceived can be targeted if within Line of Effect. Incorporeal is not removed and identity is not revealed.

warps.text: You gain a +2-status bonus to Search checks made to locate spirits, haunts or evidence of possession

system.description:
DETECTION INSIGHT SOUL UTILITY
Tradition divinity
Cast 2 AP (somatic, verbal)
Duration 10 minutes

Your vision extends partially beyond the physical world.
You can perceive disembodied spirits, incorporeal Undead, manifested haunts and the presence of an active possessing entity within another creature.
Entities perceived through Veil Sight can be seen clearly enough to target if they are otherwise within Line of Effect.
The spell does not remove Incorporeal, allow mundane weapons to affect incorporeal creatures, automatically identify spirits or reveal their allegiance. A possessing entity appears as a second spiritual presence associated with the host, but the spell does not automatically identify it or allow it to be targeted if the possession effect normally prevents this.

Warping Options:
+2 PP: Increase the duration to 1 hour.
+4 PP: You gain a +2-status bonus to Search checks made to locate spirits, haunts or evidence of possession.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 10.
